s.zh: 地精埋伏：劫掠者分成几路，从地图的不同边缘包抄过来！
s.en: Goblin ambush: the raiders split into several groups and close in from different map edges!

s.zh: 和半巫妖谈妥了：它沉回了墓穴深处，留下了
s.en: Reached terms with the demilich: it sank back into the depths of its tomb, leaving

s.zh: 放过你们。成功率 50% + 社交×3% + 冒险者等级×1%，最多 90%。\n成功：它回到墓穴深处，留下 1 份秘术残卷或 1 块神迹残片。\n失败：它立刻发动一次传奇动作。每个半巫妖只能谈一次。
s.en: to spare you. Success chance 50% + Social × 3% + adventurer level × 1%, max 90%.\nSuccess: it returns to the depths of its tomb, leaving 1 arcane fragment or 1 miracle fragment.\nFailure: it immediately takes a legendary action. Each demilich can be parleyed with only once.

s.zh: 吞下了眼魔的脑髓：脑髓补满，得到 10 天“眼魔之识”。
s.en: swallowed the beholder's brain matter: brain matter refilled, and gained 10 days of "beholder's insight".

s.zh: 这次来访已经买过情报了
s.en: Intel has already been bought this visit

s.zh: 拉洛克没有你们够格知道的情报（殖民地最高冒险者等级不够，或传奇怪 / 真龙内容没开）
s.en: Larloch has no intel you're worthy of (the colony's highest adventurer level isn't enough, or legendary monster / true dragon content is off)
Not enough silver in the home area

s.zh: 拉洛克的使者收下白银，低声说出了一个地点
s.en: Larloch's envoy took the silver and whispered a location
